notes.title: Cloudhead Games Holiday Bundle
notes.notes:
Hey all!

If you [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/cloudheadgames]follow our studio[/url], you might know that we released a new game outside of the Gallery series early last month. Pistol Whip is a new kind of action-rhythm FPS, mixing the pulse-pounding pace of an FPS with the flow-state energy of a music game. 

Pistol Whip is a gameplay departure from our puzzle/adventure fare, but shares a lot of the same values we displayed with The Gallery series and Aperture Hand Lab -- game feel, cinematic styling, and an almost-puzzle-game-like experience turn Pistol Whip from an arcade rail shooter into something unique in VR, with unprecedented player agency as a rhythm game.

As part of the Steam Winter Sale, we're introducing a limited time bundle: The Cloudhead Games Holiday Bundle, featuring both episodes of the Gallery and Pistol Whip.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13030/Cloudhead_Games_Holiday_Bundle/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7388622/a755cfc9786da34a9f9da0ce004f8ba4642d3469.png[/img][/url]

Separately, both episodes of The Gallery are 60% off, but as part of the bundle, you can claim an additional 10% off of Pistol Whip if you're interested in our latest outing. If you already own The Gallery, you can use the complete the bundle feature to collect a well-earned discount on Pistol Whip as a thank you for your support. 

If you end up grabbing Pistol Whip, or continuing your adventure with The Gallery, please leave a review for us -- they're always helpful spreading the word. 

The Cloudhead Games Holiday Bundle will be available for the duration of the Winter Sale.

Thanks as always for your support and have a great holiday season. 

Love, Cloudhead Games

notes.title: Summer Sale and Valve Index Support
notes.notes:
Hi. It's the Summer Sale. Starseed is 60% off. Emberstone is 60% off. Together they're 64% off. I don't know how that math works, but I know you can get both games for under $20. Want more games? Try the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/11133/VR_PIONEERS/]Pioneer Bundle[/url] for 63% off and get 5 of the best games in VR for a ridiculous low price.

Note: If you don't buy the game in the next 15 minutes I'm legally allowed to leave. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5046/The_Gallery__EP1_Call_of_the_Starseed__EP2_Heart_of_the_Emberstone/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30663632/32997fd619f78db58f72616158d1af99f8ecf8b8.png[/img][/url]

Now that that's out of the way...

For the upcoming launch of Valve Index, we've released a set of new controller bindings to add support for the capacitive touch features of Index. 

What this means for The Gallery is that you can naturally grab objects and interact with the world just by—and I know this is going to sound complicated, but hear me out—reaching out and grabbing. With your real hand. No buttons needed.

To enable these controls, open SteamVR and go to Settings > Controller Binding (or Devices > Configure Controller on desktop) and find The Gallery in your list of applications. For more info, check out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/526140/discussions/0/1639789306541060339/]this thread[/url].

If you've played Emberstone before on Vive or Oculus, it's like a whole new experience on Index. You basically have a Jedi force power controlled entirely by grip detection—naturally opening and closing your hand to activate. If you're new to the series, you can try a level for free with our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/767690/Heart_of_the_Emberstone_Coliseum/]Coliseum demo[/url], or start the adventure with Call of the Starseed (60% off, remember). 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/270130/The_Gallery__Episode_1_Call_of_the_Starseed/

Finally, we've launched a new collaboration with Valve called Aperture Hand Lab, a short experience that utilizes the high-fidelity finger tracking and pressure sensitivity of Index Controllers. You can try it for free starting yesterday!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/868020/Aperture_Hand_Lab/

Happy Summer!

notes.title: Happy New Year! Official Soundtrack release and Winter Sale on now!
notes.notes:
Welcome to a new year of adventure! 

To start it off right, we're releasing the Original Soundtrack for Heart of the Emberstone (done by award-winning Skyrim composer Jeremy Soule) at long last to all owners as FREE DLC. Whether you own the adventure already or if you pick it up now for 50% off during the Steam Winter Sale (until January 4), just visit our store page and find the "DLC" section to download it. 

To launch the soundtrack, go the music tab in your library. If you installed the DLC and don't see the soundtrack, go to Settings > Music > Scan Now and it should appear. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/891440/Heart_of_the_Emberstone_Original_Soundtrack/

If you're new to the adventure, or are still answering the Call of the Starseed, Episode 1 is also 50% off during the sale and also includes a free OST. And of course, pick up both episodes for an additional 10% off for a grand [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5046/The_Gallery__EP1_Call_of_the_Starseed__EP2_Heart_of_the_Emberstone/]55% discount[/url].

We've got more surprises and new reveals in store soon, so as always you can keep up with the latest releases with our swanky [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/cloudheadgames]Steam Developer Page[/url] or on social media @CloudheadGames...

notes.title: Game of the Year Celebration - 50% off!
notes.notes:
We're incredibly honoured to say that Heart of the Emberstone took home "Game of the Year" at the 2018 VR Awards! While Emberstone released at the end of last year, we missed the window for the 2017 show and were excited to be in contention for this year's contest.

Heart of the Emberstone and The Gallery as a whole has been a labour of love for us from the very beginning of this new era of VR. Among the many action and rhythm games across the platform, we know that story-driven adventure games like The Gallery are a tough sell. We appreciate all of you who have taken the plunge and joined us on this journey to something different, and we hope you can continue to join us for what we've been quietly cooking for the future of VR...

In the meantime (you know I gotta do it), if you haven't yet joined the adventure, both Heart of the Emberstone and Call of the Starseed are 50% this weekend. We'll see you on the other side of the Starseed soon.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/270130/The_Gallery__Episode_1_Call_of_the_Starseed/

notes.title: Achievements, Trading Cards, and Chinese localization now live in v1.1.0!
notes.notes:
Our latest update to Heart of the Emberstone introduces achievements, trading cards, and our first localized language. These new achievements will bring you back into the world and invite you to explore Ember in unique ways. There’s even a few secret achievements in there we think achievement hunters will really enjoy. 

We spent a lot of time trying to find a compelling way to translate a VR game without losing the original narrative built into the world. We ended up with a panelized localization system that overlays in-game texts to maintain their style. It’s pretty nifty and we feel it prevents the intent from getting lost in translation. 

Lastly, this first major update includes trading cards and badges and wallpapers and emoticons. All the snazzy stuff you need to pretty up your Steam profile with Heart of the Emberstone swag.

Full patch notes below.

[h1]v1.1.0 Changelog[/h1]
---------------

-Added Chinese Localization
-Added 27 achievements
-Steam Trading Cards will now drop during gameplay
-Fixed issue causing missing VO on Oculus
-Fixed syncing issues with some subtitles
-Reduced application filesize
-Reduced application and scene load times

notes.title: Try for free with Heart of the Emberstone: Coliseum!
notes.notes:
Introducing Heart of the Emberstone: Coliseum!

Taken straight from the heart of adventure, Coliseum is a special sandbox version of a level found in The Gallery - Episode 2: Heart of the Emberstone, made available free for virtual reality. We wanted to give players a way to delve into the mystery, master the Gauntlet, and get a taste of the world of fantasy and adventure found within The Gallery. 

This sandbox version is a telekinetic playground built for you to easily try and share a piece of the experience. If you’re new to the series, Coliseum is a way to try a slice of the game risk-free. If you’re a returning player, Coliseum offers you a quick way to wield the Gauntlet or pass a demo to a friend when you’re showing off your headset.

Really, we wanted to break up the monotony of the usual arcade fare in VR with a taste of a bigger adventure. Coliseum is a showcase for enthusiasts like you to experience tailor-made VR gameplay and story for free. 

If you like it, let us know what you think in a review, share it with a friend, and continue the adventure in the full experience. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/767690/Heart_of_the_Emberstone_Coliseum/

notes.notes:

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.2 is live!
notes.notes:
In case it wasn't obvious from the title, we’ll be continuing to support Heart of the Emberstone with updates over the weeks. Bugs, performance, some content, all sorts of flavours. 

As our first step, I'd like to introduce you to v1.0.2. It's basically the Heart of the Emberstone you've come to know and love over the last 48 hours, but with some more bug fixes! Cool, right? If you've found a bug, don't forget to let us know on our handy [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/526140/discussions/3/]bug forum[/url].

But in seriousness, thank you all so much for your support since launch--it's been incredible so far. Please keep sharing your experiences in your reviews. Post your favourite moments in the forums. Let your mom know on Snapchat, or Google+, or whatever, it’s all good. Let us know what we should keep doing, and let us know what you want to see from us in the future. You know where to find us.

[h1]v1.0.2 Changelog[/h1]
---------------

-Player can no longer pull the cog lever once already in motion
-Added haptic feedback during key moment with the Gauntlet
-Disabled key Temple moment from activating early (thanks BOLL!)
-Grab highlighter added to dead crystals
-Created automated bug reporting tool ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/526140/discussions/3/1483233503862259084/]detailed in forums[/url])
-Added SDK/Platform versioning to output log
-Resolved spamming of some broken refs

notes.title: The Gallery: Heart of the Emberstone is out now!
notes.notes:
Developing Heart of the Emberstone has been a remarkable journey. This is a VR game that is really unlike anything else in the medium right now. It's a full-fledged story-driven puzzle/adventure game that takes place on a beautiful fantasy planet, built from the ground up to make full use of virtual reality.

Heart of the Emberstone picks up exactly where Call of the Starseed left off, so if you've been holding off on playing the first episode, now's the perfect time to play them both back-to-back. You even get a 10% discount if you pick up both episodes right now. 

For those who already own Call of the Starseed, you'll also receive a 10% discount on Episode 2 when using the "Complete the Bundle" option on the store page. 

Heart of the Emberstone is a long time in the making, and we've been endlessly grateful for the support and passion from our fans over the last year and a half.

We're incredibly excited to finally be able to say: 

It's time to see the other side of the Starseed.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/526140/The_Gallery__Episode_2_Heart_of_the_Emberstone/

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - The Gallery - Episode 2: Heart of the Emberstone
notes.notes:
The Gallery - Episode 2: Heart of the Emberstone is Now Available on Steam!

After receiving your Gauntlet, a mysterious new power in the palm of your hand, you must travel to Ember, a long-forgotten world whose past holds many secrets. Find Elsie, uncover the history of Ember, and reveal the true intentions of the dark figure in the Starseed.

notes.title: An Update on Heart of the Emberstone
notes.notes:
The making of Heart of the Emberstone has been an adventure on its own, and Episode 2 of The Gallery has really become its own beast. 

This is a VR adventure that hits the high notes that fans loved about EP1, but evolves the genre in some important ways. Now that the public has become more comfortable with VR, we’re taking the gloves off with lengthier gameplay, higher puzzle density and complexity, evolved VR mechanics, and a deeper dive into the narrative of The Gallery world.

We’re incredibly proud of where we’re at with the game right now; Heart of the Emberstone is really unlike anything we’ve seen before in VR. The game is effectively finished at this point, but as a small team we’ve decided to take the opportunity to put some extra love (and bug fixes) into Emberstone before launch. We’re running out of days in September, and while “Heart of the Octoberstone” doesn’t have quite as nice a ring to it, we feel it’s the right choice to make the best game for our fans.

So, here are the facts:
[list]
[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/526140/The_Gallery__Episode_2_Heart_of_the_Emberstone/]The Gallery – Episode 2: Heart of the Emberstone[/url] will release on Wednesday, October 18, 2017.
[*]Emberstone runs most players between 4-6 hours, varying due to the openness of VR gameplay.
[*]We’re releasing at $29.99, and we’ll continue to offer dollar parity for our fellow Canadians.
[*]There will be a 10% bundle discount when purchasing both episodes, and a “complete the bundle” discount for existing owners of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/270130/The_Gallery__Episode_1_Call_of_the_Starseed/]EP1 on Steam[/url].
[*]You can currently [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/526140/The_Gallery__Episode_2_Heart_of_the_Emberstone/]wishlist the game on Steam[/url] to get launch notifications and more info as it comes.
[/list]
I’ll be around for any questions that I can answer today, and some of the other devs may chime in too. You can check our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/526140/discussions/0/3223871682618312349/]FAQ over on Steam[/url] for some answers to more common questions as well.

I’m also ethically obliged to let you know that Call of the Starseed is 50% off on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/270130/The_Gallery__Episode_1_Call_of_the_Starseed/]Steam[/url], [url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/rift/1041269642652957/]Oculus Home[/url], and [url=https://www.viveport.com/apps/386c7d8c-1f2d-4694-996a-32ab17dec7d8]Viveport[/url] right now until October 4. (This will probably be the last sale before launch because of the way the stores work, so if you want to know what the hubbub is about before EP2 releases, don’t miss this one.)

This was a hard decision to make, but we thank you as always for your support over these last few weeks and months especially. The adventure wouldn’t be possible without you.

-Cloudhead Games

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L4mNHJ1nDk4
